meta.title: Visa Master
meta.description: Prepare clearer, more consistent visa documents.

footer.disclaimer: We do not apply on your behalf, and we do not influence the consulate’s decision.

languageSwitcher.note: Switches the interface language only. The language of your document pack is set by the destination country’s requirements.

landing.intro: Prepare clearer, more consistent visa documents.
landing.cta: Sign in or create an account

route.title: Let us check whether we can help yet
route.intro: Four questions first. A combination we do not serve never creates an application, and never charges you.
route.areaLabel: Which province or municipality do you live in?
route.areaHint: A visa is handled by the consulate covering where you live, so this decides where the application is submitted.
route.destinationLabel: Which country are you going to?
route.purposeLabel: What is the main purpose of this trip?
route.employmentLabel: What is the applicant’s current work situation?

supported.title: We can prepare this route now
supported.body: A resident of the Chengdu consular district, going to Spain on a personal tourism visa, in employment. Next you fill in the application. You can leave at any point and your answers are kept.

unsupported.title: We cannot prepare this route yet
unsupported.intro: For now we serve residents of the Chengdu consular district applying for a Spanish personal tourism visa, where the applicant is employed. In your case:

reason.area: You do not live in the area the Chengdu consulate covers.
reason.purpose: The purpose is not personal tourism.
reason.employment: The applicant is not in employment.

unsupported.waitlistTitle: Tell us you needed this one
unsupported.waitlistBody: Demand decides which route opens next. The record holds only the place you live and the destination you chose.
unsupported.waitlistDone: Recorded. We will email you if this route opens.

route.createFailed: The application was not created. Try again.
route.sessionExpired: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again and your answers will still be here.
route.waitlistFailed: That was not recorded. Try again.

login.title: Sign in or create an account
login.intro: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a 6-digit code.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.failed: That code is not correct or has expired. Enter it again, or send a new one.
otp.rateLimited: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait a moment and try again.
otp.sendFailed: We could not send the code. Try again.
otp.checkFailed: We cannot check that code right now. Try again in a moment.

auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not available yet: the authentication service has not been configured.
auth.signOutFailed: Signing out did not complete. Close your browser, or try again in a moment.

empty.title: You do not have any applications yet
empty.body: Applications you create will appear here.

loadFailed.title: We cannot load your applications right now
loadFailed.body: This does not mean they are gone. Refresh the page and try again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

errorSummary.title: There is something to fix before you continue

notFound.title: This page cannot be found
notFound.body: This address does not exist, or it has moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: That did not complete. Refresh the page and try again.

validation.invalid: Check this entry and enter it again.

otp.invalidFormat: Your code is 6 digits. Check it and enter it again.

validation.tooShort: {min, plural, one {Enter at least # character.} other {Enter at least # characters.}}
validation.tooLong: {max, plural, one {Enter no more than # character.} other {Enter no more than # characters.}}

date.future: This date cannot be later than today.

pinyin.invalid: Use the Latin spelling from the passport in this field.

number.invalid: A passport number is {length} characters. Copy it from the passport and enter it again.

expiry.beforeIssue: The expiry date cannot be earlier than the issue date. Check both dates.
expiry.tooSoon: This passport has less than {monthsRequired} months left. Renew it first, then come back and prepare the documents.

intake.hubIntro: It comes in sections and you can stop at any point. Each answer is saved as you give it, and signing in again brings you back to where you stopped.
intake.saved: Saved. You can close this page at any time and carry on later.
intake.saveFailed: That answer was not saved. Try again.
intake.finishedTitle: Both of these sections are done
intake.finishedBody: The remaining sections are still being built. Everything you have answered is saved.
intake.unavailableHint: This section is still being built. Fill in the earlier ones first.

section.companions: Who you travel with, and who pays

applicant.name: What is the applicant’s name in Chinese?
applicant.nameHint: Write it as it appears on their identity card.
applicant.pinyin: How is the name written on the passport?
applicant.pinyinHint: Copy the spelling from the passport’s data page, spaces and all. Every document uses this spelling.
applicant.birthDate: What is the applicant’s date of birth?
applicant.phone: Which mobile number should we use?
applicant.phoneHint: We use it when the documents are ready, or if something is missing.

passport.numberHint: Top right of the passport’s data page. It is 9 characters.
passport.expiresAtHint: Schengen rules ask for at least 3 months of validity after you leave the Schengen area.
